create_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a GTN graph by adding start and accept nodes then connecting them with labeled arcs
test_graph_weights_get_and_set: test getting and setting graph arc weights as lists, numpy arrays, or raw pointers
test_graph_comparison_and_isomorphism: test whether two GTN graphs are equal or isomorphic using gtn.equal and gtn.isomorphic
test_scalar_graph_backward: test scalar graph operations like negate, add, subtract with autograd backward pass
test_parallel_graph_operations: test parallel batch operations on lists of graphs using gtn.negate, gtn.add, and gtn.concat
